news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.39 (vs ₹0.65 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.39 (down from ₹0.65 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹1.90b (up 17% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹17.9m (down 41% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 0.9% (down from 1.9% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 42% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 16% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: Incredible Industries Limited Appoints Raj Prakash Verma as Non-Executive (Non-Independent) Director, Effective November 14, 2025
news.body: Incredible Industries Limited has approved a notice of Postal Ballot for appointment of Mr. Raj Prakash Verma (DIN: 09305391) as a Non-Executive (Non-Independent) Director of the Company who was appointed as an Additional Director of the Company at the board meeting held on November 14, 2025. The Board of Directors had appointed Central Depository Services (India) Limited to provide e-voting facilities for the Postal Ballot. It was decided to take the cut-off date for notice of Postal Ballot as January 2, 2026. The meeting of Board of Directors of the Company was held on January 8, 2026.
